Subject: Campus stipend credits request — Unity Community Lab

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for making Redwood available — we signed up a small cohort through the PLG flow and the students are excited to start building. Unity Community Lab is a 501(c)(3) that runs free weekend AI workshops for low-income high-school students in the Bay Area. We run 5 cohorts a year (~40 students per cohort).

We wanted to request a one-time promotional credit allocation to cover student experimentation (not for commercial use). Ideally we'd receive a pool of credits we can distribute as stipend codes to students (redeemable on sign-up) or a single organization account credit we can draw from.

Attached: copy of our 501(c)(3) certificate and a roster + short program outline.

What information do you need from us to approve? We can also share a short statement of use and expected token consumption per student.

Appreciate any help — we hope to run the workshop on 4/26 and would love to have credits available by then.

Best,

Hi Amy — glad you reached out and congrats on the cohort launch.

High level: we can approve a time-limited stipend credit allocation for community/edu labs. Two common options we offer:
- Promo code redeemable by students during signup (self-serve, preferred for distribution)
- Centralized org credit applied to a Redwood account (we bill against the org pool)

For a first pass, we typically approve up to $500 equivalent per cohort (approx. 100k tokens) or greater amounts for multi-cohort programs with evidence. Given your size, I can propose a 100k-token pool to start, redeemable via code, and we can revisit after your workshop.

To proceed I need: 1) 501(c)(3) proof (received), 2) program roster (received), 3) confirmation of the email domain students will use (if you want student-level redeemable codes) OR the org account email (if you want a single pool).

If you need the credits by 4/26, let me know whether you want a redeemable code (we can create one instantly) or an org credit (ops will apply and it can take up to 48 hours).

Next steps:
- Reply with preferred distribution method ("redeemable code" or "org pool")
- If redeemable code: confirm number of codes and per-code amount (we can do 40 codes x 2.5k tokens each or one 100k pool code)
- If org pool: provide the account email (or HubSpot deal id) to attach the credit to

I can also loop in billing for a manual override if you need larger allocation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
